FAQs
What are Tenable Professional Services?
Tenable Professional Services are any engagements with our expert consulting team. They are a group of elite security specialists who partner with your organization to help you plan, deploy, and optimize your
Tenable solutions
. Whether you're just getting started or maturing your program, Tenable services accelerate your time-to-value, lower your risk, and ensure you are maximizing your investment to build a proactive
exposure management program
.
Why use Tenable Professional Services?
Tenable Professional Services expertly reduces adoption risk by leveraging proven expertise to ensure a successful implementation, which saves time and money. The service maximizes your return on investment by accelerating the learning curve, so your team can gain value and prioritize exposures as quickly as possible. Ultimately, Tenable provides ongoing strategic advice and optimization to empower your team to be self-sufficient and ensure your security program’s lasting success.
Does Tenable Professional Services offer educational programs?
Yes. Tenable education programs build deep product knowledge and skills, making cyber professionals feel more confident, credible, and effective. Explore all available
customer training and certification
courses.
If I’m already a Tenable customer, can I use Tenable Professional Services to optimize my current deployment or further explore an
exposure management program
?
Absolutely. We meet you where you are. Tenable services are ideal for existing customers looking to enhance their security posture. We can conduct a health check of your current deployment to identify optimization opportunities, help you fine-tune your processes, and build a strategic maturity roadmap to evolve your existing vulnerability management practice into a comprehensive exposure management program.
How does pricing work for Tenable Professional Services?
Pricing for Tenable Professional Services is based on the specific services you need. We offer a range of engagement models, from fixed-price, short-term workshops (like a Health Check or a Design and Architecture session) to broader, customized services for longer-term strategic guidance.
Because every organization's goals and environment are unique, we work with you to define the scope of the engagement first. Please contact our sales team so we can understand your objectives and provide a customized quote.
Does Tenable offer managed services?
Tenable's in-house team focuses on professional services, which are designed to empower and enable your own team. We provide expert consulting, implementation, optimization, and training to help you build and manage a world-class program.
For organizations seeking to outsource the day-to-day management of their security program, Tenable has a vast, global ecosystem of certified
managed security service provider (MSSP) partners
who offer Tenable Managed Services. These partners use Tenable's platform to manage your security operations for you.
If my organization isn’t ready for an exposure management program, can Tenable Professional Services still help me build a roadmap so that we can mature over time?
Yes! Tenable has professional services for all solutions to fit your needs. Whether you’re looking to implement a
vulnerability management program
,
cloud-native application protection platform
(CNAPP),
patch management
,
identity security
,
operational technology (OT) security
,
unified vulnerability management program
, or
exposure management program
, we can help your organization deploy the best solution.
If I already deployed Tenable One, can Tenable Professional Services provide a shorter workshop to help me optimize my program?
Yes. We offer targeted workshops and health checks specifically for
Tenable One
customers. These collaborative sessions review your current architecture and use cases, align the platform's capabilities with your specific business goals, and ensure you are taking full advantage of all features, from unified visibility and
vulnerability prioritization
to
attack path analysis
, risk-based reporting, and more.
